policy_interface: TcPolicy.choose(tuple[RegionState]) -> WorkRequest; allocation-only state; caller executes matching allocation and production work and charges both

initialization.coverage: choose lexicographically first minimum-count region until all counts >=16

candidate.Q: area^2 * sum_c(standard_error[c]^2); integrated descriptive pixel uncertainty proxy
candidate.model_gain: Q * 4/(n+4), n=current samples_per_pixel; constant-variance reduction heuristic
candidate.recent_gain: max(area^2 * recent_improvement,0) * (n-4)/(n+4); if unavailable, use model_gain
candidate.uncertainty_bonus: 0.25*model_gain; fixed heuristic, not a statistical confidence bound
candidate.cost_predictor_seconds: estimated_sample_cost * area * 4 from latest allocation request; not paired production cost or primary time
candidate.exploration: every 16th post-initialization decision choose least samples_per_pixel region, geometry tie key
candidate.tie: greatest exact finite score then geometry tie key; no after-outcome tie tolerance

ablations.equal-cost: same full feedback/gain/exploration, replace cost denominator by1; constant-allocation-cost equivalence must remain visible
ablations.no-feedback: after all regions reach16, freeze n0*Q0, recent coefficient=max(area^2*recent_improvement0,0)*n0*(n0-4)/4 or model coefficient if unavailable, and initial measured allocation cost; model/recent gain = frozen_coefficient*4/(n*(n+4)); track counts administratively from chosen work, validate caller count transitions, never use later means/variance/SE/improvement/cost for scores

information: no reference, production state/error, future sample, scene-family label or model oracle; frozen no-feedback coefficients are allocation observations only
traces: allocation state snapshot, candidates including predicted gain/bonus/cost/score, decision reason, chosen WorkRequest; caller supplies subsequent state, actual paired charged work and complete end-to-end timing
stopping: policy never infers target/error or stops from these proxies; common caller fixed decision horizon in synthetic prototype only; final ray/time cap, overshoot and stopping semantics remain integration prerequisites
limitations: descriptive SE/variance, signed observed improvements and allocation-cost proxies can be inaccurate, especially for rare paths; independent allocation/production streams alone do not prove finite-budget or optional-stopping unbiasedness; no optimality/performance claim
